Nursing Posts Update
Friday, 21 April 2023
4198 Hits
NOTING
The nursing written examination & interview conducted on 25/03/2023, 27/03/2023 & 28/03/2023 respectively, stands cancelled.
The date of fresh written examination will be notified soon on the website
All applicant who applied for last advertisement will be eligible for written examination.
Medical Superintendent
Kasturba Hospital
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
